_comment: Stage 0 performance budgets, checked by tools/ci/check_bench.py in the CI bench job. budget_ms is an absolute ceiling on a CI runner (about 3x the 2026-11-21 measurement on a 2-vCPU machine, so a slower runner still passes); the job also fails any benchmark that regresses more than 10 % against the base commit on the same runner. See docs/design/performance-budgets.md.

doc/edit-one-of-100k.what: one expression edit, committed, in a 100 000-object document: interactive edits must stay far below a 16 ms frame

doc/undo-redo-100-steps.what: 100 undo steps then 100 redo steps (the Stage 0 gate's undo check) in a 1 000-object document

doc/recompute-chain-1000.what: edit the head of a 1 000-expression dependency chain and recompute it: recompute time

file/open-10k-objects.what: open a part with 10 000 objects read-only: open time

file/save-10k-objects.what: save a part with 10 000 objects (atomic replace, journal reset)

kernel/native/block.what: a block through KernelHost::op (history checked), released

kernel/native/drill-block.what: a block minus a through cylinder: the commonest feature recompute

kernel/native/mass-properties.what: volume, area and centroid of the drilled block (Information, mass checks)
